errors.text_span: 关系抽取、召回率和 F1 值这三种功能
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the first metric as "关系抽取" (Relation Extraction). The legend in the image clearly labels the first metric (blue bar) as "准确率" (Precision/Accuracy). Relation extraction is the overall task being evaluated, not the performance metric itself.
The description states that the interval on the vertical axis is 10. However, the axis labels (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100) clearly show an interval of 20.
The description claims the vertical axis is "marked as percentage", but there is no percentage sign (%) visible on the axis in the image.
